name: Bedford (United States)
description: The historic Bedford Flag: a crimson damask field charged with a mailed arm emerging from clouds grasping a sword, three cannonballs and a gold ribbon reading VINCE AUT MORIRE.
history: Bedford is a town in Middlesex County, Massachusetts. Its flag is the historic Bedford Flag preserved in the Bedford Free Public Library, a colonial militia cavalry standard believed to have been carried by the Bedford Minuteman Nathaniel Page to the Concord Bridge on 19 April 1775, and the oldest complete flag known to exist in the United States.
